svg.data-tcam: TCAM option available to meet diverse deployment requirements (datasheet)
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 (default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 with an additional licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC, Class C timing accuracy; NOS integration is required to activate any of it
svg.data-gnss: integrated receiver covering GPS/QZSS L1 C/A, GLONASS L1OF, BeiDou B1, SBAS L1 C/A (WAAS, EGNOS, MSAS, GAGAN) and Galileo E1B/C, RF sensitivity -166 dBm; passive and active antennas are both supported and auto-detected (HIG Installing an Antenna)
svg.data-antenna: an active GNSS antenna needs 50 ohm impedance matching, 5 V DC, a noise figure of 1.5 dB maximum and an internal LNA gain of 35-42 dB; the port supplies up to 5 V DC / 150 mA and a surge protector is required (HIG Installing an Antenna)
svg.data-macsec: MACsec on all ports (datasheet feature list)
svg.data-srv6: full Segment Routing over IPv6 (datasheet feature list)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR; 10G SFP+ SR/LR, up to 40 km
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the four SFP+ management ports take 10G SFP+ SR/LR from the datasheet's Compatible Transceivers list; no separate reach or media list is published for this block - the HIG's Port Overview table does not cover it at all (see the sfp-plus-management-role gap)
svg.data-sfp28-sharing: the four SFP28/SFP-DD ports are in-band port share with 100GE port 0 (datasheet)
svg.data-timing-cable: 50 ohm SMA coaxial with a 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS, 50 ohm SMB coaxial with a 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz, shielded RJ45 for ToD and shielded RJ48 for BITS, none longer than 3 m (datasheet Compatible Timing Cable Types; HIG section 12)
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS in on SMA, 10MHz in/out on SMB, 1PPS in/out on SMB, ToD in/out on RJ45, BITS in/out on RJ48
svg.data-console: RJ45 RS-232 plus a micro-USB serial console
svg.data-sfp-plus-management: 4x 10G SFP+ management ports, numbered 0-3 in their own space
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A; NEBS GR-1089

g.data-description: led-oob-left: the left lamp inside the out-of-band jack's own aperture, drawn dark in the datasheet render. THIS VOCABULARY IS NOT SOURCED FOR THIS DEVICE: HIG section 10 tables the six front-panel lamps and the two FRU lamps and gives this jack no table at all, so the wording is borrowed from the S9510-28DC and S9311-64D guides, whose Management Port LED tables give 1G green on the left and 10M/100M amber on the right for the same class of jack on the same vendor's boxes. It is an inference from a sibling document and is recorded as one; led-oob-right: the right lamp inside the out-of-band jack's own aperture, drawn dark in the datasheet render. THIS VOCABULARY IS NOT SOURCED FOR THIS DEVICE: HIG section 10 tables the six front-panel lamps and the two FRU lamps and gives this jack no table at all, so the wording is borrowed from the S9510-28DC and S9311-64D guides, whose Management Port LED tables give 1G green on the left and 10M/100M amber on the right for the same class of jack on the same vendor's boxes. It is an inference from a sibling document and is recorded as one
g.title: oob

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYNC row - Off (system timing/clock synchronization is disabled or in free-run mode), Solid Green (timing core synchronized to PTP packet phase or an external phase source and frequency locked), Blinking Green (synchronized to PTP packet frequency or an external frequency source), Solid Yellow (acquiring state or holdover), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail, or acquiring/holdover time out)
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, SYS row - Off (no power), Solid Green (host CPU/BMC boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but the host CPU/BMC boot failed)
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, FAN row - Off (fans are not initialized), Solid Green (all fan modules working normally), BLINKING Amber (one or more fan modules need service). The blink is the vendor's, and it is the one row where this guide differs from the S9600-56DX's, whose fan fault is solid
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PS0 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 working normally), Solid Amber (PSU0 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, PS1 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 working normally), Solid Amber (PSU1 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG Front Panel LED table, ID row - Off (no power), Solid Blue (Reserved), Blinking Blue (beacon feature enabled). The only blue lamp on the panel
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: the 2x2 SFP+ quad below the SFP28 block, '4 x 10G SFP+ management ports' in the datasheet and '4x SFP+ Management' in HIG Figure 4's callout. The vendor numbers them 0-3 in a space of their own, which is why they are not port-N
